pkgmetadata.longdescription: Kanidm is a simple, secure and fast modern identity management platform built in Rust. It provides OAuth2/OIDC SSO, WebAuthn, RADIUS, Linux PAM/NSS integration, SSH key distribution, and a read-only LDAPS gateway.

use.flag: Build and install the kanidmd server daemon
Build and install the kanidm CLI client
Build and install kanidm_unixd local resolver and helper tools
Build and install the NSS module (libnss_kanidm.so.2)
Build and install the PAM module (pam_kanidm.so)
Enable TPM-backed HSM key storage in the unix resolver (requires app-crypt/tpm2-tss)
Install the pykanidm Python client library (kanidm + kanidm_openapi_client modules) for integration scripts
